claims.claim: Centrus Q2 2026 issuer results reported a $900 million DOE HALEU enrichment award, contingent LEU/HALEU enrichment backlog of $3.0 billion, a construction contractor selected for major enrichment expansion and a first new centrifuge targeted for completion by year-end 2026.

risks.risk: Contingent backlog and contract awards are not equivalent to realized revenue and expansion output.

unknowns.unknown: Timing, capital cost and production ramp economics for full-scale enrichment expansion remain to be underwritten by Alpha.

claims.claim: Centrus generated Q2 revenue of $176.1 million, up 14% year over year, while LEU segment revenue rose 22%; however GAAP net income declined to $16.8 million from $28.9 million, so demand/backlog momentum should not be conflated with uniform earnings expansion.

risks.risk: Quarterly mix and contract timing can create material earnings volatility despite strategic backlog growth.

unknowns.unknown: Alpha must normalize segment mix and contract timing before assigning financial-momentum scores.
